parameters.name: FILENUM
parameters.help: Which SEQUENTIAL field record number do you wish to start with on this tape? (1st?, 2nd?, 10th?)

parameters.name: IMULTIPL
parameters.help: Specify the SEG-D tape format.

parameters.name: SCSI1
parameters.prompt: MAXIMUM data block size in bytes
parameters.help: Maximum size of a data block in bytes that will be encountered. For values greater than 65536, you must have a long block driver.

parameters.name: SCSI2
parameters.prompt: MAXIMUM data block size in bytes
parameters.help: Maximum size of a data block in bytes that will be encountered. For values greater than 65536, you must have a long block driver.

parameters.name: SEGDDBUG
parameters.help: SEGD will show general header(s), channel set(s), trace header and extended trace header information.

parameters.name: OMITFATL
parameters.help: SEGD will ignore fatal errors, skip the record and keep going.

parameters.name: SEGDOGH
parameters.prompt: Override the Additional General Header Block count (GH)?
parameters.help: In some rare cases, SEGD input data may incorrectly specify the number of additional general header blocks.

parameters.name: SEGDNGH
parameters.prompt: Number of additional general header blocks
parameters.help: Enter the number of additional 32 byte general header blocks.

parameters.name: EXHGEOM
parameters.prompt: Extract geometry from extended trace headers?
parameters.help: The extended trace header integer source and receiver station and line values are good, use them.

parameters.name: EXHXGEOM
parameters.prompt: Extract extended geometry from extended trace headers?
parameters.help: The extended trace header fractional source and receiver station and line values are good, use them.

parameters.name: SEGD_THE
parameters.prompt: Honor the Trace Header Extension value (THE)?
parameters.help: SEGD (default) will honor THE only when the values in the channel set and trace header match.  This option signals SEGD that the value in the trace header is good and to use it (USE with SERCEL 368).

parameters.name: SEGDOTHE
parameters.prompt: Override the Trace Header Extension value (THE)?
parameters.help: In some rare cases, SEGD input data may incorrectly specify the number of trace header extensions in both the channel set and the trace header.

parameters.name: SEGDNTHE
parameters.help: Enter the number of 32 byte trace header extension blocks on each trace.

parameters.name: ADJTRLEN
parameters.prompt: Auto adjust incorrect trace data length?
parameters.help: If the chan set start/end times are incorrect, traces may not be read. If this condition is detected, this option will attempt to adjust the data and/or header length so the traces can be decoded correctly.

parameters.name: OMITREC
parameters.help: This is a record rejection method based upon the general header record type. '-1' disables the option otherwise records of these type will be skipped.

parameters.name: SEISCN
parameters.help: Change the default seismic data channel type '1'.

parameters.name: AUXCN
parameters.help: Change the default aux channel type '8'.

parameters.name: ZEROCN
parameters.prompt: Specify Zero or Pad Channel Type(s)
parameters.help: Enter channel types defined as Pad/Zero Traces. '-1' disables the option.

parameters.name: ABORT
parameters.prompt: Number of errors in a row before ABORTING job?
parameters.help: Specify the number of errors in a row before aborting. '0' means ignore all errors. Greater than '0' will output dead traces until number of errors is reached.

parameters.name: HEAD_LEN
parameters.help: The SEG-D main header length in bytes. Enter 0 to calculate from header values.

parameters.name: DISPFLAG
parameters.help: Specify whether to display information for each ensemble input into ProMAX.

parameters.name: FORMAT
parameters.help: Specify the format code (data recording method) of the data samples on tape. 80?? is for demultiplexed and 00?? is for multiplexed formats.

parameters.name: MAXDTR
parameters.help: Maximum number of traces per record (shot). Enter 0 to calculate from header values.

parameters.name: AUXOPT
parameters.help: Auxiliary traces may either be input normally or ignored.  (Include in above parameter.)

parameters.name: TMAX
parameters.help: Amount of data to input, in milliseconds. (Enter 0.0 to read all available data!)

parameters.name: SERCEL
parameters.help: Sercel uses alternate locations than standard SEG-D for critical parameters.

parameters.name: MPFACTOR
parameters.help: Specify whether to apply the pre-amplifier gain to the trace data.gain = 2. ** MP. The MP factor occupies byte 8 of the channel set descriptor.

parameters.name: TMULTIPL
parameters.help: Specify method for getting scan corrections (sample skew statics).

parameters.name: STATIC
parameters.help: Access the text editor to define the scan corrections for each channel. Static times must be in microseconds.

parameters.name: TTRACE
parameters.prompt: Get CHANNEL NUMBER from trace headers?
parameters.help: Do you wish to get the channel number from the trace headers or number the channel sequentially in a ensemble?

parameters.name: INKEYNAM
parameters.help: How (based on what SEG-D or ProMAX header word) is the primary input record list specified?

parameters.name: PMODE
parameters.help: The records in the list can be either INCLUDED or EXCLUDED from the following processes.

choices.label: Include
choices.help: INCLUDE the records in the list.

choices.label: Exclude
choices.help: EXCLUDE the records in the list.

parameters.name: TRC_LIST
parameters.help: Access the text editor to define the records that are to be read in.

parameters.name: CHAN_KEY
parameters.help: The SEG-D record can be secondary sorted by input channel/trace number.

parameters.name: SMODE
parameters.help: The channels in the list can be either INCLUDED or EXCLUDED from the following processes.

choices.label: Include
choices.help: INCLUDE the channels in the list.

choices.label: Exclude
choices.help: EXCLUDE the channels in the list.

parameters.name: CHANLIST
parameters.help: Access the text editor to define the channels/traces that are to be read in.

parameters.name: STRMLCHN
parameters.help: If Yes, SEG-D Input quickly forward spaces its input to the next record once it encounters channels beyond the selected range.

parameters.name: IOVER
parameters.help: Choose 'YES' to input/override SEGD main header values.

parameters.name: OVERRIDE
parameters.help: Enter: 1-8 char keyword, 1-32 char description, 1I 2I 4I #B #C 4RIBM 4RIEEE 8R, channel set delimiter, byte increment, byte start/ ... /

parameters.name: ITOVER
parameters.help: Choose 'YES' to input/override SEGD trace header values.

parameters.name: TOVERRID
parameters.help: Enter: 1-8 char keyword, 1-32 char description, 1I 2I 4I #B #C 4RIBM 4RIEEE 8R, channel set delimiter, byte increment, byte start/ ... /

parameters.name: COORREF
parameters.help: Specify whether to input the global reference coordinates 'xref' and 'yref'. If 'NO', then these parameters are not used.

parameters.name: XREF
parameters.help: Enter the global X reference coordinate. All X coordinates will have this reference subtracted from their original value.

parameters.name: YREF
parameters.help: Enter the global Y reference coordinate. All Y coordinates will have this reference subtracted from their original value.

parameters.name: NGAIN
parameters.prompt: Save trace IFP values for NGAIN Instrument Test?
parameters.help: Choose 'YES' to save the trace sample IFP values to a file. The file is required to run the Ngain Instrument Test.

parameters.name: GAINFILE
parameters.prompt: Enter NGAIN disk file path name
parameters.help: This specifies the disk file path name to save the IFP values for the Ngain Instrument Test  The full path is not necessary if the file is in the database.
